page.title: Starlite 2039: Pre-Concert Yacht Charter from Marbella Marina

data.meta_description: Book a Starlite 2039 pre-concert yacht charter from Marbella Marina. Cruise the Costa del Sol at sunset with champagne & snacks before the show. From €749.
data.summary: Combine a luxury yacht charter from Marbella Marina with your Starlite 2039 concert night. Depart Puerto Banús for a sunset cruise, then arrive at the festival relaxed and ready.
key_facts: Charter departs from Puerto Banús, a 10-min drive from Starlite.
Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) from €749 for 2 hours.
All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and IVA.
Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) from €4,719 for 4 hours with jet ski.

faq.q: What time should I start my pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: We recommend departing Puerto Banús around 18:00–19:00 for a 2-hour sunset cruise. This gives you time to enjoy the coast, sip champagne, and arrive back at Marbella Marina by 20:00–21:00, leaving a comfortable window to reach Starlite (a 10-minute taxi ride) before the headline act.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food and drinks?
faq.a: Our charters already include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. If you have specific dietary requirements or want to bring your own bottle, you're welcome to — just let us know in advance. No corkage fee.

faq.q: Which boat is best for a pre-concert group?
faq.a: For a group of 8–10, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (€749/2h) are ideal — spacious flybridge, good sound system, and a bar setup. For a VIP experience with up to 12 guests, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) includes a jet ski and more deck space.

faq.q: How do I get from Marbella Marina to Starlite?
faq.a: Marbella Marina is about 5 km from Starlite. A taxi costs roughly €10–15 and takes 10 minutes. We can also arrange a private transfer for your group (quote on request). No need to rush — most acts start around 22:00.

faq.q: What happens if the concert is cancelled?
faq.a: If Starlite cancels the event, we offer a full refund or reschedule for your charter. If you cancel, our standard policy applies: 48 hours' notice for a full refund, less than 48 hours forfeits the deposit.

faq.q: Can I extend the cruise after the concert?
faq.a: Absolutely. Many guests book a longer charter (4–8 hours) that includes both a pre-concert sunset cruise and a post-concert return to the boat for late-night drinks. Check availability for your date via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Is the charter private or shared?
faq.a: Every charter is private — just your group and the skipper. No shared tables or strangers. You control the music, the route, and the pace. Perfect for a Starlite evening with friends or family.

faq.q: What's the dress code for a pre-concert yacht charter?
faq.a: Smart-casual is the norm: summer dresses, linen shirts, deck shoes. Bring a light jacket — the breeze picks up after sunset. Heels are fine on the flybridge but avoid stilettos on the teak deck.

data.body_html:
Starlite 2039 is back, and Marbella's biggest concert series deserves a grand entrance. Instead of battling traffic from Puerto Banús, step aboard a private yacht at Marbella Marina, cruise the Costa del Sol at golden hour, sip cava, and arrive at the festival relaxed and ready. A Starlite 2039 pre-concert cruise Marbella turns your night out into a full Mediterranean experience — and it's easier to book than you think.

Why start your Starlite night on the water?

Starlite is held at the Auditorio de Cantera de Nagüeles, about 5 km inland. The road from Puerto Banús can get congested on concert nights. A pre-concert yacht charter lets you skip the pre-show stress entirely. Depart from Marbella Marina, glide past the Golden Mile, watch the sun drop behind La Concha, and dock back in time to grab a taxi to the festival. You arrive already in holiday mode — not frazzled from traffic.

Which boats are available for pre-concert charters?

We operate from Puerto Banús with a fleet that suits every group size and budget. For a Starlite pre-concert cruise, the most popular choices are:

  • Tier A — Astondoa 40 & Azimut 39: 12.5 m, 9–11 guests, from €749 for 2 hours (includes skipper, drinks, snacks, IVA). Ideal for couples or small groups wanting a quick sunset spin.
  • Tier B — Mangusta 80: 24 m, 12 guests, from €4,719 for 4 hours (includes a jet ski). Best for a VIP group that wants to make an evening of it.
  • Other boats: From the Ferretti 94 (29 m, 12 pax) to the Lagoon 380 catamaran (11.6 m, 10 pax) — all available on request. Pricing via WhatsApp.

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and safety equipment. No hidden extras.

Sample pre-concert itinerary

Here's a typical 2-hour Starlite 2039 pre-concert cruise Marbella schedule:

  • 18:30 — Meet at Puerto Banús. Board your yacht, meet the skipper, quick safety briefing.
  • 19:00 — Depart. Head west towards Cabopino or east towards Cala del Faro, depending on wind and sunset position.
  • 19:30 — Drop anchor for a swim (if weather permits) or just cruise with drinks and music.
  • 20:30 — Return to Marbella Marina. Disembark.
  • 20:45 — Taxi to Starlite (€10–15, 10 minutes).
  • 22:00 — Headline act begins.

If you want more time on the water, upgrade to a 4-hour charter and add a post-concert return to the boat for late-night drinks under the stars.

What's included in the price?

Transparency is key. When you book a yacht charter in Marbella for Starlite, this is what you get:

  • Licensed, English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full charter duration
  • Unlimited water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts, fruit)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) — included in the price, not added at checkout

No mooring fees, no cleaning fees, no tips required. Just show up and enjoy.

How to book your Starlite 2039 pre-concert cruise

Booking is straightforward. Visit our boat rental page, check availability for your preferred boat, or send us a WhatsApp message with your date, group size, and preferred start time. We'll confirm availability within minutes and send a secure payment link. Late bookings are common — we keep a few slots open for last-minute Starlite guests.

Tips for the perfect pre-concert evening

  • Dress smart-casual: Summer dresses, linen, deck shoes. Bring a light jacket for the breeze after sunset.
  • Arrive at Puerto Banús 15 minutes early to park and find the boat. Parking can be tight on concert nights.
  • Bring sunscreen: Even at 18:30, the sun is strong in June–September.
  • Tell us your music preference: Our boats have Bluetooth speakers. Create your own pre-concert playlist.
  • Book a taxi in advance: We can arrange a private transfer from the marina to Starlite for €20–30 (up to 7 guests).
